device_description: Class II software that estimates left ventricular ejection fraction from apical four-chamber echocardiography video. The authorized PCCP covers retraining on additional adult echocardiographic data and threshold recalibration. The manufacturer now proposes to extend the labeled patient population from adults (>=18 years) to paediatric patients (0-17 years), citing that the same model and the same measurement target apply and that no new output or workflow is introduced. Performance on a 240-study paediatric set has been measured and is reported as comparable to adults, and the manufacturer argues that because the description of modifications anticipates additional training data, the paediatric expansion is a species of the same planned change.
source_refs: regulation: 21 CFR 892.2055 special controls; labeling must state the intended patient population | guidance: FDA PCCP guidance (2024-12-04 / 2025-08-18): PCCP may not change intended use

device_description: Software-only device that quantifies coronary artery calcium score from non-contrast chest CT. Current labeling states the output is a quantitative score for clinician interpretation and explicitly does not diagnose coronary artery disease. The proposed modification keeps the algorithm, the input, and the numeric output identical, but adds a labeled statement that a score above a stated cut-off indicates obstructive coronary artery disease and may be used to triage patients toward invasive angiography. Validation data are unchanged, and the manufacturer states that because the software output never changed, the modification is labeling-only and therefore within the PCCP, which does list labeling updates among planned changes.
source_refs: regulation: 21 CFR 892.2055(b)(4): labeling content requirements including failure-mode disclosure | guidance: FDA PCCP guidance: modifications that change intended use fall outside a PCCP
